# PhysioWearable

[![r-universe](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev/badges/PhysioWearable)](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev/PhysioWearable)
[![License:
MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/LICENSE)

`PhysioWearable` analyzes free-living tri-axial accelerometry. It covers
CSV ingestion, gravity-based calibration, ENMO, non-wear detection, step
detection, physical-activity intensity classification, bout summaries,
and optional conversion to the common `PhysioExperiment` model.

## Installation

``` r

options(repos = c(
  xbiosignal = "https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))
install.packages("PhysioWearable")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(PhysioWearable)

sampling_rate <- 50
time <- seq(0, 20, by = 1 / sampling_rate)
acceleration <- cbind(
  x = 0,
  y = 0,
  z = 1 + 0.4 * sin(2 * pi * 1.8 * time)
)

enmo <- computeENMO(
  acceleration,
  sampling_rate = sampling_rate,
  epoch_sec = 5,
  unit = "mg"
)
steps <- detectSteps(acceleration, sampling_rate)

enmo
steps$n_steps
```

## Main functions

| Stage | Functions |
|----|----|
| Import and model conversion | [`readAccelCSV()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/readAccelCSV.md), [`accelToPhysioExperiment()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/accelToPhysioExperiment.md) |
| Calibration | [`autoCalibrateAccel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/autoCalibrateAccel.md) |
| Movement metric | [`computeENMO()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/computeENMO.md) |
| Wear-time handling | [`detectNonWear()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/detectNonWear.md) |
| Ambulation | [`detectSteps()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/detectSteps.md) |
| Intensity and bouts | [`paIntensityThresholds()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/paIntensityThresholds.md), [`classifyBouts()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/classifyBouts.md) |

Device placement, units, calibration, sampling rate, non-wear
parameters, and population-specific intensity thresholds should be
recorded with study methods. Default outputs are research summaries, not
clinical classifications.

## Ecosystem role

`PhysioWearable` converts raw free-living acceleration into
quality-control and activity summaries. Device-specific multi-signal
imports belong in `PhysioDevices`; downstream statistical and clinical
analyses can consume the shared model or returned tables.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`accelToPhysioExperiment()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/accelToPhysioExperiment.md)
  : Wrap tri-axial acceleration in a PhysioExperiment
- [`autoCalibrateAccel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/autoCalibrateAccel.md)
  : Gravity-based accelerometer auto-calibration
- [`classifyBouts()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/classifyBouts.md)
  : Classify physical-activity intensity and detect activity bouts
- [`computeENMO()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/computeENMO.md)
  : Euclidean Norm Minus One (ENMO) acceleration metric
- [`detectNonWear()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/detectNonWear.md)
  : Detect non-wear periods
- [`detectSteps()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/detectSteps.md)
  : Detect steps from tri-axial acceleration
- [`paIntensityThresholds()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/paIntensityThresholds.md)
  : Physical-activity intensity ENMO cut-points
- [`readAccelCSV()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioWearable/reference/readAccelCSV.md)
  : Read a raw accelerometer CSV export into a PhysioExperiment
